description: Use this when the user wants to write a new paper letter from text and post it, for example to cancel a contract, subscription or membership by letter, file a complaint or objection, or send a formal notice, by ordinary or registered mail. Renders an A4 letter (DIN 5008 layout: sender block with the user's own name and address, recipient, place and date, subject, body, closing, signature) that passes the print check, and creates a draft with the exact price. Nothing is sent or charged: show the user the draft and the total, ask for confirmation, then call send_letter. The sender can live in any country. Body supports paragraphs (blank line), '- ' bullets, '1. ' lists and **bold**. Needs the user's account.

body.description: Letter text including the salutation (e.g. 'Dear Sir or Madam,'), without closing or signature. Blank line = new paragraph; '- ' bullets, '1. ' numbered lists and **bold** work. Up to 20,000 characters.

closing.description: Closing phrase, e.g. 'Kind regards'. Default: the usual closing in the letter's language.

color.description: "bw" = black and white, "color" = colour printing (costs more per page). Default "bw".

date.description: Date of the letter as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2026-10-08. Default: today.

duplex.description: true = print on both sides of the paper (fewer sheets, so a lighter letter); false = one side only. Default false.

envelope.description: "DL" (220×110 mm, letter folded twice), "C5" (229×162 mm, folded once) or "C4" (324×229 mm, flat). Omit to use the smallest envelope that holds the sheets (recommended); one too small for the page count is refused.

language.description: Language of the letter as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, pt, it or nl; sets the date format and the default closing. Default "en".

place.description: Place printed before the date, usually the user's city, e.g. Berlin. Optional.

recipient.description: Recipient's postal address, printed in the letter's address field and on the envelope. Ask the user for missing fields.

company.description: Recipient's company or organisation, e.g. Example GmbH. Optional.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR or US.

line1.description: Street and house number, or PO box, e.g. Hauptstraße 5.

line2.description: Optional extra address line: c/o, apartment, floor or building, e.g. Apt 4B.

name.description: Recipient's name: a person, or a department such as Customer Service when writing to a company, e.g. Erika Mustermann.

postal_code.description: Postcode / ZIP code, e.g. 10115 or 94105. Required in countries that use postcodes.

region.description: State, province or region. Required for recipients in AE, AS, AU, BR, CA, CN, CO, CR, ES, FM, HK, HN, ID, IN, IQ, IT, JM, JP, KN, KR, KY, MH, MP, MX, NR, PF, PG, PW, RU, SO, SV, TW, US, VE, VI, VN (without it the draft is refused: INVALID_ADDRESS, fields.region); omit where addresses have none, e.g. DE, FR or GB. The code in US, CA, AU and BR, e.g. CA (California) or ON (Ontario); elsewhere the name or its usual abbreviation, e.g. Madrid (ES) or RM (Rome, IT).

references.description: Up to 5 reference lines printed above the subject, e.g. ["Customer no. 12345", "Contract no. 987"]. Optional.

registered.description: true = registered mail: tracking number and signature on delivery, for an extra fee (also what "certified" letters, Einschreiben, lettre recommandée and carta certificada mean here; not a US certified-mail product). false = ordinary mail. Default false. Often wanted for cancellations and deadlines.

sender.description: The user's own name and address (any country), printed in the letter's sender block (the envelope always shows our return address)

company.description: The user's company or organisation, e.g. Example GmbH. Optional.

country.description: Country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR or US.

email.description: The user's email address, printed in the sender block, e.g. max@example.com. Optional.

line1.description: Street and house number, or PO box, e.g. Hauptstraße 5.

line2.description: Optional extra address line: c/o, apartment, floor or building, e.g. Apt 4B.

name.description: The user's full name, e.g. Max Mustermann.

phone.description: The user's phone number, printed in the sender block, e.g. +49 30 1234567. Optional.

postal_code.description: Postcode / ZIP code, e.g. 10115 or 94105. Required in countries that use postcodes.

region.description: State, province or region where the user's country has one in addresses, e.g. CA (California, US), ON (Ontario, CA) or Madrid (ES). Optional in the sender block.

signature.description: Name printed under the closing, e.g. Max Mustermann. Default: the sender's name.

subject.description: Subject line printed above the body, e.g. Cancellation of my contract no. 12345 (up to 200 characters).

name: compose_letter
title: Compose a letter
